Jazak Allah Khairan for the suggestion.

We can only add resources we have the right to share. If you know the author or publisher, it would help a lot to:

- find out whether the resource is under a licence that allows sharing, or
- ask the publisher for permission, and have them open a [licence or permission issue](https://github.com/TarteelAI/quranic-universal-library/issues/new?template=licence_permission.yml).

Please share anything you find here.
